description: Strodina is a space-focused team interested in science, technology, and digital storytelling. We aim to uncover the stories behind forgotten space exploration equipment and missions, connecting historical discoveries with modern digital experiences. Through research, creativity, and collaboration, we want to make space exploration history more accessible and engaging.
summary:
Forgotten World is an educational web platform that explores human-made equipment left behind during space exploration missions on the Moon and Mars.

Developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, the project addresses the challenge of telling the stories behind abandoned space exploration equipment. It presents information about selected artifacts, including their original purposes, mission histories, and contributions to scientific exploration.

Using a 5W + 1H storytelling approach, Forgotten World aims to make the history of lunar and Martian exploration easier to understand and more accessible to the public.

The project encourages people to recognize that these objects are not simply forgotten equipment, but part of humanity's continuing journey beyond Earth.
details:
Project Overview

Forgotten World is an educational web platform that explores human-made equipment left behind during space exploration missions on the Moon and Mars.

How It Works

The platform organizes selected artifacts into two exploration categories: Moon and Mars.

Each artifact is presented through historical and educational information using the 5W + 1H approach:

  • What: What is the artifact?
  • Who: Who developed or used it?
  • When: When was it used?
  • Where: Where was it left?
  • Why: Why was the mission conducted?
  • How: How did the equipment work?

The project uses structured JSON data to organize artifact information and present it through a web interface.

Benefits and Intended Impact

Forgotten World aims to make the history of space exploration easier to understand and accessible to a wider audience.

By exploring equipment left behind on the Moon and Mars, users can learn about past missions, technological achievements, and the scientific contributions of space exploration.

The project also encourages curiosity about astronomy, planetary science, and humanity's exploration beyond Earth.

Technology and Tools

  • HTML5
  • CSS3
  • JavaScript
  • JSON
  • GitHub
  • Vercel

Creativity and Approach

Instead of treating abandoned equipment as ordinary objects, Forgotten World presents them as part of a larger story of human exploration.

The 5W + 1H approach helps organize historical information into clear and understandable explanations.

Development Considerations

The project prioritizes accessible educational content, clear information structure, and reliable references. Historical and scientific information should be supported by credible sources.
